entities.name: Dwarves
entities.description: A creature type of short, human-like folk, many bearded miners and artisans, that appear across many planes.

entities.name: Sardian dwarves
entities.description: Dwarves of the Sardian Mountains who served Urza, traded with Mishra, and were slaughtered after rising against Argive.

entities.name: Sarpadian dwarves
entities.description: Dwarves of the Sarpadian Mountains whose empire fell to goblins and orcs and who were teleported to Terisiare.

entities.name: Pardic dwarves
entities.description: Hardy miners and warriors of the Pardic Mountains on Otaria, some enslaved by the Cabal.

entities.name: Stone dwarves
entities.description: Blue-skinned dwarves who practiced earth and fire magic.

entities.name: Duergars
entities.description: Twisted, gnome-like dwarves of Shadowmoor who live deep underground.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: An artificer who used the Sardian dwarves' clay for his statues and the Colossus of Sardia.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Urza's rival, with whom the dwarves also traded.

entities.name: Lady of Otaria
entities.description: A being summoned by the Sarpadian dwarves who teleported them to Terisiare.

entities.name: Sister Nadeen Dormet
entities.description: The leader of the Stone Druids who caused the volcano housing the Rathi Stronghold to erupt.

entities.name: Thane Torbran
entities.description: A member of the council of the Eldraine dwarves.

entities.name: Court of Embereth
entities.description: The Eldraine court whose primary inhabitants are dwarves.

entities.name: Assault on Delverhaugh
entities.description: A massive food fight that ended the long dwarf and redcap feud.

entities.name: Baron Sengir
entities.description: A vampire who invaded New Freedom on Ulgrotha and turned Irini into a vampire.

entities.name: Irini
entities.description: Princess of the Ulgrotha dwarves turned into a vampire and adopted by Sengir.

entities.name: New Freedom
entities.description: The underground dwarf city on Ulgrotha topped by the Castle of Morning Light.

entities.name: Axgard
entities.description: The harsh mountainous land of the dwarves of Kaldheim.

entities.name: Karona
entities.description: A being whose coming caused a calamity on Otaria.

entities.name: Lord Skitter
entities.description: A rat who inhabits ancient dwarven ruins below Edgewall.

events.summary: The Sardian dwarves, found to be trading with Mishra too, rise against Argive and are slaughtered.
events.quote: they eventually rose against Argive, and for this, they were slaughtered

events.summary: The Sardian dwarves' mountains are devastated and their numbers dwindle in the Ice Age.
events.quote: Their mountains were devastated during the war

events.summary: The Sarpadian dwarf empire falls to migrating goblins and orcs, and the Lady of Otaria teleports the dwarves to safety on Terisiare.
events.quote: she teleported them to salvation on Terisiare

events.summary: Stone Druids led by Sister Nadeen Dormet make the volcano housing the Rathi Stronghold erupt during the Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: caused the volcano in which the Rathi Stronghold was situated to erupt

events.summary: The dwarf-redcap feud on Eldraine boils over into the Assault on Delverhaugh.
events.quote: The feud boiled over in a massive food fight known as the Assault on Delverhaugh .

events.summary: Baron Sengir invades New Freedom, chases off the dwarves and turns Princess Irini into a vampire.
events.quote: even turned their princess Irini into a vampire whom he adopted as his daughter
